description.en: Unlocks a director/manager, by director ID, optionally selecting them and/or marking them as newly unlocked.
ID of the director to unlock, e.g. "iim0001".
Optional; whether to set this director as active.
Optional; whether to flag the director as newly unlocked.
True once the call has taken effect (including as a no-op if no ID was resolved); null if the call was invalid (no arguments at all).

example.code:
// Unlock the starting director, flagged as newly unlocked but not selected
CMND_ADD_SET_DIRECTOR("iim0001", false, true);
